info.note: Lists are published as newspaper legal ads. Results and excess funds are not posted online.

auction.venue: Douglas County Government Annex Building, front steps (Tax Commissioner's Office)
auction.time: First Tuesday of months with a scheduled sale, 10:00 am (legal hours 10:00 am to 4:00 pm, continuing Wednesday if necessary)
auction.payment: Cash, certified check or money order, paid in full. The time to remit payment is set on the day of the sale.
vital: Buyer beware (O.C.G.A. 9-13-167): no guarantees and the Levying Officer does not warrant title.
Opening bid includes all applicable taxes, penalties and costs; a no-bid property may be re-offered the same day.
The owner may redeem within 12 months by paying the bid plus a 20% premium (10% for each additional year); the buyer may not take possession before then.
The Sheriff's Tax Deed is recorded within 30 days of the sale; the Levy Officer may void a sale within 30 days with a full refund.
The list of properties is posted on the website 30 days before the sale.
Excess funds are claimed on the Levying Officer's claim form or paid into Superior Court by interpleader (O.C.G.A. 48-4-5).
auction.confirmed: Latest posted list is for the June 2, 2026 sale; site copyright 2026
